text: Find a current enterprise technology architect who has led cloud and microservices modernization for banking or financial-services systems, can design secure APIs and modern application platforms, and has managed sizeable onshore and offshore engineering teams.

Find a current business systems analyst in financial services who understands ACH, check processing, remittance processing, document processing, and corporate reconciliation, and can work with vendors on system management, incident resolution, data analysis, and process improvement.

Find a software procurement and strategic sourcing professional who can manage supplier onboarding, contract negotiation, RFQs, spend analytics, stakeholder alignment, and Agile procurement projects, with evidence of leading workstreams or assigning team tasks.

Find a legal professional with hands-on federal bankruptcy experience across Chapter 7, 11, 12, and 13 matters, creditor or governmental-entity representation, property-tax collection, legal document preparation, and experience leading a litigation-support or skip-tracing workstream.
Find a current luxury-goods or jewelry retail sales professional with high-end customer service, diamond or jewelry knowledge, trend analysis, and brand-ambassador or client-advisor experience.
